cards.title: Water temperatures: target, to heating and back

cards.content:
Every day the thermostat checks whether each room was warm on time without getting too warm, how often the burner started and how much gas went to heating.

<details><summary>More</summary>

It learns from this; every figure keeps its history on its own sensor.

</details>

{% set mode = state_attr("sensor.fixture_hub_heat_request", 'mode') %}{% if mode == 'active' and state_attr("sensor.fixture_hub_heat_request", 'control') == 'awaiting_confirmation' %}Next step: run the boiler test and confirm the takeover on the E32 Rooms page.{% elif mode == 'active' %}The E32 controls the boiler.{% elif mode == 'shadow' %}Trial run: the E32 calculates along but does not control the boiler yet; your current thermostat or the boiler's own control stays in charge.{% else %}The E32 keeps your rooms running, also without Home Assistant.{% endif %}

<details><summary>More</summary>

{% if mode == 'active' and state_attr("sensor.fixture_hub_heat_request", 'control') == 'awaiting_confirmation' %}Until then the E32 sends nothing to the boiler.{% elif mode == 'active' %}{% elif mode == 'shadow' %}{% endif %} The E32 keeps your rooms running, also without Home Assistant.

</details>

<details><summary>Meer</summary>

</details>

cards.title: Watertemperaturen: doel, naar verwarming en terug

cards.content:
Elke dag kijkt de thermostaat of elke ruimte op tijd warm was zonder te warm te worden, hoe vaak de brander startte en hoeveel gas naar verwarmen ging.

<details><summary>Meer</summary>

Hij leert daarvan; elk getal houdt zijn geschiedenis bij op zijn eigen sensor.

</details>

{% set mode = state_attr("sensor.fixture_hub_heat_request", 'mode') %}{% if mode == 'active' and state_attr("sensor.fixture_hub_heat_request", 'control') == 'awaiting_confirmation' %}Volgende stap: doe de keteltest en bevestig de overname op de E32-pagina Ruimtes.{% elif mode == 'active' %}De E32 regelt de ketel.{% elif mode == 'shadow' %}Proefperiode: de E32 rekent mee maar stuurt de ketel nog niet; je huidige thermostaat of de eigen regeling van de ketel blijft de baas.{% else %}De E32 houdt je ruimtes op temperatuur, ook zonder Home Assistant.{% endif %}

</details>
